|sellprice = 5 |quality = false |xp = 1 [[Foraging#Experience Points|Foraging XP]] }} '''Moss''' is a [[:Category:Resources|resource]] obtained from moss-covered trees. Each day in [[Spring]], [[Summer]], and [[Fall]], common [[trees]] can randomly grow moss. Moss grows slower on sunny summer days. Additionally, two types of [[Green Rain Trees]] can grow Moss. Moss growth is accelerated for these two trees, and when covered in moss and planted near common trees accelerate moss growth on the common trees. The trees do not need to be felled to collect the Moss. Moss can be removed and collected with any [[Tools|tool]], [[Weapons|weapon]], or [[Crafting#Bombs|bomb]]. One tree drops 1-2 pieces of Moss. Players can use [[Vinegar]] on a tree to prevent that tree from growing Moss. Using an [[Axes|Axe]] on a tapped tree covered in Moss will remove the [[Tapper]] and the Moss in one hit, while a [[Pickaxe]] will remove only the tapper on the first hit. Using any other methods will harvest moss without collecting the tapper. Moss becomes much more common during the [[Weather#Green Rain|Green Rain]] event, covering most trees. Additionally, this events spawns [[Weeds#Special Weeds|special weeds]] that have a 10% chance to drop Moss when cut. Large Weeds spawned by the event will drop 2–3 Moss when cut. No other types of trees can grow moss. However, if a tree with moss turns into a [[Mushroom Tree]], the Mushroom Tree will have moss. The tree's [[Trees#Growth Cycle|growth stage]] must also be at least 14. At the start of each day, all eligible trees will have a chance to grow Moss. The chance for a tree to grow moss varies depending on the weather and season. The growth chance is 10% on [[Sunny]] days, which decreases to 3.3% if it is [[Summer]]. On [[Rain|Rainy]] days, the growth chance is 20%. Trees will have a 50% chance to receive a 10% boost to their moss growth chance if one of the following conditions are met: * The tree is a (non-temporary) Type 1 or Type 2 [[Green Rain Trees|Green Rain Tree]]. * The tree's surrounding 5x5 grid contains a (non-temporary) Type 1 or Type 2 [[Green Rain Trees|Green Rain Tree]] that has Moss on it. During the [[Weather|Green Rain]] event, all mature trees that are able to grow Moss will instantly grow it. During [[Winter]], Moss cannot grow at all (except inside the [[Greenhouse]]), and all pre-existing Moss on trees is removed. Collecting moss from a tree reduces its growth stage to 12 - the amount of Moss it dropped. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem
